 Membership Magic Beyond Renewed for 2027, Benefits Include Discounts on Theme Park Tickets
 Alice Kennedy 
 Published: November 10, 2026 
 Membership Magic Beyond Renewed for 2027, Benefits Include Discounts on Theme Park Tickets
 DVC’s Membership Magic Beyond has been renewed for 2027. Included benefits feature discounts on Walt Disney World and Disneyland Resort tickets.
 Membership Magic Beyond
 Eligible DVC Members can purchase the 2027 benefits package starting January 1, 2027, for $99 with usage through December 31, 2027. The 2026 benefits package is still available for purchase for $99 for usage through December 31, 2026.
 Starting January 7, Members who purchase Membership Magic Beyond save $150 per ticket on Walt Disney World 5-day Weekday Theme Park tickets, with the Water Park and Sports Option. The discounted ticket is valid Monday-Friday only for theme parks and any day of the week for water park and sports-related visits. Standard tickets are valid any day of the week. It’s available for ticket start dates of January 11, 2027 through December 16, 2027.
 See more details here . Last year, the benefit included a $140 discount.
 Members can also purchase a 3-day weekday Disneyland Resort Park Hopper Ticket for $117 per day (total of $350) starting January 7. Additional details are available here . Last year, Members saved $177/ticket.
 Read more about Membership Magic Beyond and the included benefits here .
 Are you a DVC Member? Will you purchase the Membership Magic Beyond add-on for 2027? Let us know in the comments and on social media.
